source_doubts.where: Corollary 1.2 (two unions) in the SOURCE; Corollary 5.1 / Section 5.2, proof steps (3) and (5), in the REWRITE
source_doubts.quote: By Li's result \cite[Corollary~3.1]{Li26} in Park's fractional-cover formulation \cite[Theorem~3.4]{Park26}, this family has a fractional cover of cost at most $1/2$ at $r=p/2$. ... The companion expectation-threshold theorem~\cite[Theorem~1.1]{OpenAIThreshold26} then gives an integral cover of cost at most $1/2$ at $r/(25\cdot512^4)$.
source_doubts.problem: This is a dependency caveat, not a detected error. The corollary's proof is carried entirely by two external results quoted by number only: the fractional cover at density p/2 under mu_p(D) > 1/2, and constant-factor rounding with constant 25*512^4 from an unrefereed companion preprint. Neither the hypotheses of those theorems nor the constants can be checked from the manuscript. The internal steps are correct: E_2(D) is nonempty, proper and increasing; capping coefficients at 1 preserves coverage and does not increase cost; and (p/2)/(25*512^4) = p/(50*512^4). The corollary is not used in the proof of Theorem 1.1, Lemma 2.1 or Proposition 3.1, all of which I checked step by step in the source and found sound.

unverified_marks.where: Section 5.2, box immediately after the proof of Corollary 5.1 (two-union corollary)
unverified_marks.concern: Steps (3) and (5) rest on the external inputs (I1) (Li Cor. 3.1 / Park Thm. 3.4: fractional cover of E_2(D) at density p/2) and (I2) (companion preprint Thm. 1.1: rounding to an integral cover at density sigma/(25*512^4)). The source cites these by number without stating them, so the rewriter could not check their hypotheses, the density p/2, or the constant.
